title: Exposure provenance map and rollback telemetry flow
creator: Ava Chen
description: Build a compact, scannable UI canvas that visualizes how traffic exposure flowed across segments during a staged rollout, surfaces provenance of signals used to trigger rollforward/rollback decisions, and provides a lightweight telemetry-driven rollback flow for on-call and PM review. This prototype focuses on a read-first exploratory map (exposure provenance) and an actionable rollback storyboard that ties metrics to decisions.
acceptance_criteria: A clickable exposure map shows cohort-level traffic weights over time (t0..tn) with hover state revealing request routing rules and model variant IDs.
Provenance panel lists signals (latency P95, error rate, quality regression score, cost spike) along with the exact metric query and timestamped evidence used in the last 3 decision points.

Rollback storyboard allows an engineer to select a decision point, preview the proposed rollback (target variant, target traffic split), and run a simulated impact forecast using recent telemetry windows.
Prototype screens exist in Figma for three states: Overview (map + provenance), Deep-dive (metric timelines and traces), and Action (rollback preview + confirm), with annotated accessibility notes.
Design includes microcopy for confidence scores and a clear primary action for emergency rollback with a secondary ‘dry-run’ option.
Links to a sample query set and the dashboard used in the simulation (Grafana link) are included in the ticket comments.
Design review feedback from Eng and PM is captured and either resolved or has follow-up tasks listed in comments.
comments: 2025-01-29 Ava Chen: Initial discovery—spoke with oncall (Diego) about common rollback workflows. He emphasized the need to see the exact decisioning window and the metric query used to avoid opaque rollbacks.
2025-02-03 Priya Kapoor: First pass prototype uploaded to Figma. Focused on compactness: we collapse cohort lanes when counts are low and surface detailed rules on demand.
2025-02-05 Liam O'Neal (Eng): Technical constraints—live simulation will be bounded to 1-hour windows for initial MVP due to query cost. Suggest adding a cached-snapshot mode for older decisions.
2025-02-07 PM-Review: Product requests an explicit ‘confidence score’ derivation and that the UI show which model variant is compatible with fallback policies (dedicated vs hosted).
2025-02-10 Design critique: Accessibility pass required for color-blind variants of the lane heatmap. Also, add keyboard shortcut to open the rollback modal for oncall speed.

2025-02-14 Priya Kapoor: Updated prototype includes provenance panel and a ‘simulate rollback’ preview that overlays expected P95 and error-rate delta based on last 15m of telemetry. Linked a working Grafana panel used for calculations.
2025-02-17 Eng review (Diego Martinez): Implementation notes—need endpoint for provenance events; will scope ENG-2843 to add a compact provenance API and a cached last-5-decisions store.

2025-02-18 Ava Chen: Ready for stakeholder walkthrough. Outstanding: finalize microcopy for emergency rollback confirmation and add telemetry attribution tooltip per signal. Follow-ups added as sub-issues.
